rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; on the zero-tax evaluation, with scope for the not-elected return. i1116 p. 2, "To make the election, just enter on the foreign tax credit line of your tax return (for example, Schedule 3 (Form 1040), Part I, line 1) the smaller of (a) your total foreign tax, or (b) your regular tax."; p. 2, Who should file, "File Form 1116 to claim the foreign tax credit if the election, earlier, doesn’t apply and: ... You paid or accrued certain foreign taxes"; p. 25, Line 20, "Individuals. Enter the total of Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 16, and Schedule 2 (Form 1040), Part I, line 1z, less any tax included on line 16 from Form 4972." Triage executable-triage-v2 (triage/ftc.json; 1,228 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 200 partial records): 1,229 of 1,928 comparisons agree; kinds {"candidate-refuses": 454, "candidate-unknown": 244, "project-refuses": 1}; by return {"completed": {"candidate-unknown": 70}, "incomplete": {"candidate-unknown": 86}, "refused": {"candidate-refuses": 454, "candidate-unknown": 88, "project-refuses": 1}}. Both sides now read regular tax as Form 1040 line 16 plus Schedule 2 line 1z (the BUG-0190 fix), so the limit itself is not in dispute; the candidate's zero floor is redundant, since both terms are NonNegDollars and the Form 8978 and Form 4972 adjustments are refused (scope.other_line16, scope.credits). (1) candidate-unknown (70 on completed returns): with no foreign tax (ftc.taxes $0.00) the candidate still evaluates the election conditions and smaller_of(ftc.taxes, regular tax), so it needs Form 1040 line 16 and the answers below it (witness stage10.ira.fully_taxable, incomplete: project $0.00, candidate unknown for s1a.tips). With no foreign tax the credit is zero whatever the regular tax ("the smaller of (a) your total foreign tax"), so this is an answer the source does not need: a model error. (2) candidate-refuses: every one is on a return the project refuses anyway (for example classm.f8889.5.deepseek, gate scope.schedule1; classm.f4952.3.deepseek, gate sa.dependent): the candidate reaches a refused line 16 on a zero-tax return where the project shows $0.00. No tax quantity differs on a completed return. (3) project-refuses, scope: stage4.refuse.ftc.election (foreign tax with the conditions met and ftc.elect false): the project refuses with gate ftc.needs1116 ("The small-tax election is unavailable or not chosen. Form 1116 is deferred, not dropped"), the candidate enters $0.00. Without the election the credit is claimed on Form 1116 (p. 2, Who should file), which this tool does not prepare; the project's refusal is a cited screen, and the candidate's $0.00 would drop a credit the source allows.

Ruling: representation on completed supported returns; i1116 (2025) pp.1-2 Election To Claim ... Without Filing Form1116 explicitly instructs the smaller of total foreign tax and regular tax, despite waiving the Form1116 lines15-23 limitation. That primary text establishes the shared min expression. With positive tax, admitted cases meet the election conditions and both use that min; the reply floors regular tax at zero, redundant for the supported computed nonnegative line16. With zero tax and a completed no-election answer the reply returns zero, as confirmed by .transcription/ftc-zero-tax-source-witness.json. Excluded regimes and absent election answers are not asserted equivalent.
